title: A 1,500-character Hospital pre-round: every lab, medication and study is kept, and plan items after character 1,200 still become tasks
goal: Open the chart of {hospitalPatient} on the Pre-Round tab. Open the pre-round notes editor and type this text into the pre-round observations box exactly as written (typing stands in for dictation): "Pre-round review for today, written from the morning list before rounds. Hospital day 5 for community-acquired pneumonia, now with a PICC line for IV antibiotics. Overnight quiet, no new complaints, slept well. Labs this morning: WBC 11.2, hemoglobin 10.9, platelets 312, sodium 136, potassium 3.8, chloride 101, bicarbonate 24, BUN 18, creatinine 1.07, glucose 141, magnesium 1.9, phosphorus 3.3. Chest X-ray shows the right lower lobe consolidation slightly improved. CT chest from Tuesday showed a small right parapneumonic effusion, not loculated. Renal ultrasound shows no hydronephrosis. Medications: ceftriaxone 2 g IV daily, azithromycin 500 mg daily, enoxaparin 40 mg subcutaneous daily, pantoprazole 40 mg daily, metoprolol tartrate 25 mg twice daily, atorvastatin 40 mg nightly, and acetaminophen 650 mg every 6 hours as needed. She is walking in the hall with physical therapy twice a day and eating most of her meals without nausea. Her daughter visited yesterday evening and asked about the expected length of stay and whether she will need home oxygen. Oxygen was weaned to room air yesterday afternoon and she has stayed comfortable since. The PICC site was clean this morning with no redness or tenderness. She asked again about going home, and we went over the remaining steps in plain terms. Continue the current antibiotics for now and reassess the total course length with pharmacy. Plan: ask infectious disease about removing the PICC line, and book a repeat echocardiogram for Friday." Press Save Note and wait until the editor closes and the panels below it update. Save checkpoint 1 with the Labs, Diagnostic Testing and Medications panels visible (scroll and save more of the page if needed). Open the Encounter tab, wait until its Tasks list stops changing (up to 30 seconds) and save checkpoint 2.
